Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.502 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376-D,
302, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Mahmoodabad, District Sitapur.
3. In terms of the FIR a missing person report was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years was enticed away by the co-accused Suraj.
Subsequently, the body of the victim was recovered.
As per the postmortem report, it is indicated that the victim was subjected to strangulate.

Subsequently, the statement of the informant was recorded, wherein, the informant stated that the applicant used to come to her home along with his friend Aditya and an apprehension had expressed that both of them had enticed the daughter.

sentences.text: name of the accused in the FIR was stated on account of suspicion.
Subsequently, at the instance and pointing out of the applicant, the body of the deceased was recovered.
The statement of one of the witnesses who was working as Chaukidar in a form house is recorded after seeing the photograph of the applicant.
He had seen both the co-accused and according to him, they used to take the victim to the farm house and had allegedly committed the offence.
There are no eyewitness to the offence in question.
The statement of last seen of the Chaukidar and the recovery of the body at the instance and pointing out of the applicant are corroborated.
4. Considering the fact that a young girl of 17 years was raped and killed.
The offence is a very heinous, as such, no case for bail is made out.
The bail application is accordingly rejected.
5. However, the trial court is directed to ensure that the charges are framed with all expeditions within four weeks and the proceedings of the trial starts expeditiously.
6. The applicant would be at liberty to revive his bail after recording the statements of substantial witnesses.
